title: Keep the sharper information ratio distinct from ordinary discrimination
statement: For two linearly independent pure preparations of overlap s, the acquired pure-pair proof gives equal-reference minimum retention1-s^2; the accepted mixed-family theorem gives the same sharp conditional extension. For the SAME0,+ pair this gives reverse factor2, whereas the optimal ordinary uniform-success unambiguous inverse has success1-s and bound2+sqrt2. No improved physical success probability follows. The earlier pure-pair consumer did not resolve unequal-reference subtraction; its own receipt and regularization amendment remain distinct.
